title: ArcReel market-source index
description: Root arcreel-market.json in market-source repositories. Compatibility: no level sets additionalProperties: false, so older clients ignore unknown optional fields; unknown-type entries need only be objects with type and are silently skipped by clients. Reject the entire index when its major version exceeds the client (checked by arcreel_market_core.market.index before schema validation). Added fields increment minor; changed semantics increment major.

semver.$comment: Same construction as definition schemas: [0-9] rather than \d, plus newline-rejecting not (Python $ permits trailing newlines). Include type inside not so nonstrings produce only type errors. Length limits keep components within integer-conversion bounds.

relativePath.$comment: Repository-relative path: no leading / or scheme, no .., backslashes, whitespace, or control characters. Resolve relative to the index_url directory.

endpointEntry.description: Invocation-endpoint entry: definition meta projection plus sidecar assets.
